# Wenbu · 问卜

> Free tools for BaZi, I Ching, tarot and Zi Wei. Deterministic calculations and random draws are separate from optional AI interpretation. Symbolic reflection is not factual prediction.

## Tools
- [BaZi calculator](https://wenbu.genedai.me/en/bazi/): date, time, timezone and explicit calendar conventions
- [I Ching](https://wenbu.genedai.me/en/iching/): three-coin method with all changing lines
- [Tarot](https://wenbu.genedai.me/en/tarot/): full 78-card deck, one or three cards
- [Zi Wei](https://wenbu.genedai.me/en/ziwei/): twelve palaces and named calculation conventions

## Agent integration
- [MCP endpoint](https://wenbu.genedai.me/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP
- [Agent guide](https://wenbu.genedai.me/en/agents/)
- [OpenAPI schema](https://wenbu.genedai.me/openapi.json)
- [Skill](https://wenbu.genedai.me/SKILL.md)
- [CLI](https://wenbu.genedai.me/wenbu.mjs)
- [Context schema](https://wenbu.genedai.me/context.schema.json)
